content: Wode wurseththa bolla issi issi asay ammano aggidi baleththiza ayanatanne iita ayana timirte kaallanayssa Xillo Ayanay qonccera yootees.
Hessa mala timirtey istta qofay bonqo biratan xuugettida mala geellateththan doccida qoodheppe qommon haniza wordanchcha asatappe yaana.
He asati asay ekkontta malanne gelontta mala diggana; ammanizaytinne tumaa shaakki eriza asay Xoossi medhdhida kath galatarakka ekkizayti montta mala diggananne azazana.
Xoossi medhdhiday wurikka lo7o; asi galatara ekkiko wora wodhdhizay issinakka deenna.
Hayssa ha azazoza ammaniza asaa ne qofsikko, ammano qaalaninne ne ekkida lo7o timirtezan minnada Yesus Kirstoosas lo7o oosanchcha gidandasa.
Xoos bonchchisontta go7ay baynda haysi7eppenne cima maccassata haysi7eppe haakkada tuma ayana oosos ne asateth giigsa.
Asateththaa asho ogen dosisoy guuththa wodes go7ees shin Tumu Ayana duussas bana tamaarsoy gidikko hayssa ha alamezassinne buro yaana duussaas hidotay diza gishshas ubbaas go7ees.
Hayssi ha qaalay ammanettidayssanne ubbay ekkanaas bessiza qaala.
daaburoos; hessika asa ubbaas harappeka ammanizaytas ashshiza de7o Xoossaan nu hidota ooththiza gishshassa.
Ne yelagateththaa oonikka leqqofo; gido attiin neni haasayan, duussan, siiqon, ammanoninne geeshshateththan ammanizaytas lo7o leemiso gida.
Ta hee baana gakkanaas qaalaa nababanaas, zoranaassinne tamaarsanaas minna.
Cimati ne bolla ba kushe woththi woossishin, nees imettida tinbite imoteththaa leppi histta aggofa.
Asi wuri ne dichchaa beyana mala ha yo7ota lo7eththa minththada dandayan pola.
Ne duussaa gishshassinne ne tamaarsiza timirtezas naagetta; haytan minna; ne hessa ooththiko nenanne ne gizayssa siyizayta ashshana.

footnotes.text: Dafettoos: Dafettoos gizayssa issi issi birsheththa maxaafati, «Baaxetoos» gishin issi issineti, «Cayettoos» giidi birshida.
